name: implementation-workflow
description: Japanese implementation planning, auditing, execution, and correction-learning workflow for Codex and Claude Code, with curated persistent guidance and deterministic guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, audit, implement, verify, and retain accepted corrections
interface.longDescription: A shared implementation workflow for Codex and Claude Code. It audits existing implementations, creates executable Japanese implementation plans, executes accepted plans with verification, and converts accepted human corrections into deduplicated repository guidance, reusable skills, or deterministic guardrails without persisting raw conversations.
